name: Iyengar Yoga Dunedin
reason: Health rule: a one-teacher studio (Demelza Campbell) whose site is framed mainly around health and therapy: workshops listed on the home page are on lower back, lung health, neck and shoulders and hormone balancing, it runs 'Well Being Plus' and personalised therapeutic programmes, and the founder's story centres on her own medical condition and therapy intensives. Little would pass the health rule beyond general classes and a practice-room membership. robots.txt open; email published.
